findings.issue: CreateWorkspaceDialog swallows API errors in catch block without setting error state or user feedback
findings.impact: When workspace creation fails, the dialog simply resets the loading spinner with no error message.
findings.fix: Set error state in catch block (e.g. setError('Failed to create workspace')) and ensure Input displays the error prop.

findings.issue: MessageItem component receives 17+ props via manual drilling from MessageList, creating tight coupling
findings.impact: Adding features requires threading new props through all intermediate components. Component is impossible to reuse outside MessageList.
findings.fix: Consolidate callbacks into action handler objects (messageActions: { onReply, onEdit, onDelete, onThreadOpen }) and group display data into a dedicated interface.

findings.issue: Settings page notification changes are applied locally immediately but only persisted on manual Save, with no dirty-state indicator or unsaved changes warning
findings.impact: Users can change toggles, see visual feedback, and navigate away losing all changes without warning.
findings.fix: Add dirty-state flag showing 'Unsaved changes', implement beforeunload/navigation guard when dirty, or auto-save each toggle with debounce.

findings.issue: Auth loading state uses inline Tailwind class 'border-foreground' rather than a CSS custom property
findings.impact: Border color may not respond correctly to theme changes or dark mode, creating visual inconsistency.
findings.fix: Replace border-foreground with border-[var(--color-border-primary)] consistent with workspace loading.tsx skeletons.

findings.issue: Search author filter accepts raw UUID strings instead of offering member name autocomplete
findings.impact: Users must know exact user UUIDs to filter by author, making the feature effectively unusable.
findings.fix: Replace plain text input with member typeahead that searches workspace members by display name, resolving to UUID internally.
